entry.title: Gate of Felicity, Topkapi Palace

groundCutout.basis: Existing standard PMTiles/Mapzen terrain retained. Native front-path control internal[3.8,23] sets Y0; rear control[3.8,-12] defines the modest through-passage cross slope. Connected wings follow nine front-ground samples along their length, preserving original terrain outside the tightly occupied mapped parent. Roof/floor subdivisions follow those controls; columns remain upright. This is an explicit approximate adaptation to the host terrain, whose eastern wing drops several metres. No broad courtyard slab, terrain flattening, independent-building replacement or water cutout. Original native terrain, footprint ownership, front-facing entry and approximate exterior contact were visually inspected2026-10-21 and accepted. The independent Audience Chamber procedural shell meets the rear boundary and obscures a distant rear view; the authored rear portico remains intact and is inspected from inside its own footprint. Exact historical wing levels and host terrain accuracy remain approximate.

terrainReference.basis: Existing standard front path control internal[3.8,23]; nativeY0. Actual provider ground reference, independent of model-interior roof heights.
